nodes.description: uint16 internal constant TOKEN_SCALE = 1000; factor by which ETH contributions multiply into crowdfund tokens.
uint256 internal constant REENTRANCY_NOT_ENTERED = 1; reentrancy guard constant.
uint256 internal constant REENTRANCY_ENTERED = 2; reentrancy guard constant.
uint8 public constant decimals = 18; ERC20 decimals.
address payable public operator; operator with special role to change contract status.
address payable public fundingRecipient; recipient of funds.
uint256 public fundingCap; hard cap for raising funds.
uint256 public operatorPercent; operator equity percentage in tokens.
string public symbol; ERC20 symbol.
string public name; ERC20 name.
Status public status; current campaign state (FUNDING or TRADING).
uint256 internal reentrancy_status; reentrancy guard storage.
uint256 public totalSupply; ERC20 total supply.
mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf; ERC20 balances.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance; ERC20 allowances.
mapping(address => uint256) public nonces; signature nonces.
address public logic; delegatecall implementation address.
constructor initializes logic, operator, fundingRecipient, fundingCap, operatorPercent, name, symbol from factory msg.sender and sets status to FUNDING.
fallback delegates all calldata to logic implementation via delegatecall.
receive external payable function accepting ETH.
msg.sender used as the factory address in constructor external calls.
External call ICrowdfundFactory(msg.sender).logic() during construction; returns implementation address.
External call ICrowdfundFactory(msg.sender).parameters() during construction; returns operator, fundingRecipient, fundingCap, operatorPercent, name, symbol.
delegatecall in fallback to logic with calldata; executes untrusted implementation code in proxy storage context.
Local address _impl assigned from logic state variable in fallback.

edges.reason: msg.sender is cast to ICrowdfundFactory and used as target for logic() external call; unvalidated caller controls implementation address.
msg.sender is cast to ICrowdfundFactory and used as target for parameters() external call; unvalidated caller controls initialized parameters.
Return value of logic() is assigned to logic state variable.
First return value of parameters() is assigned to operator state variable.
Second return value of parameters() is assigned to fundingRecipient state variable.
Third return value of parameters() is assigned to fundingCap state variable.
Fourth return value of parameters() is assigned to operatorPercent state variable.
Fifth return value of parameters() is assigned to name state variable.
Sixth return value of parameters() is assigned to symbol state variable.
logic state variable is read into local _impl.
delegatecall executes in proxy context with original msg.sender, allowing caller context to reach implementation.
delegatecall to logic can call back into proxy fallback, enabling reentrancy.

normalization_plan.reason: Local variable _impl is only a temporary copy of logic passed directly to delegatecall; it can be inlined into the delegatecall unsafe operation.
